none: PAS NLM-F09826: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: [--]CLAVD[--]. Reverse description: Female figure standing left, her left arm raised. Reverse inscription: NE[--], CR offers alternative reading: AN[NONA]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.7mm, Weight: 2.24gms, die axis: 12
